name: Churn Step
description: Stir the qi in both legs into a churn so each pace lands at a different length than the last.

name: Jostle Palm
description: Shake the palm as it strikes so the blow lands as a jostling knock that unsettles the foe's stance.

name: Rattle Guard
description: Rattle the forearm against the incoming blow with quick shaking qi so it breaks apart and slides off.

name: Twitch Kick
description: Snap a kick out of a twitch of the hip that gives no sign of its aim until it lands.

name: Pattern Rend
description: Strike the foe's chest as they commit to a technique so the qi of that technique tears apart in their body.

name: Discord Strike
description: Land a blow loaded with clashing qi that hurts the target and leaves their own flow out of step.

name: Shuffle Step
description: Shuffle the feet through a changing pattern of short and long paces to hide where the body will end.

name: Shifting Palm
description: Change the shape of the striking hand twice on its way so the guard meets a different blow than it set for.

name: Mismatch Chop
description: Chop at the foe's neck with a hand edge whose qi arrives a beat before or after the hand.

name: Whirling Ward
description: Rotate a shell of qi round the body in uneven turns so no blow meets the same face twice.

name: Warp Slip
description: Bend the body through the line of a strike with a warping twist and send the force past.

name: Wander Jab
description: Let the jab wander off its line in flight and then dart back to the open spot.

name: Pattern Shift
description: Change the whole pattern of stance and qi as a blow arrives and answer it from the new angle.

name: Warp Sweep
description: Sweep a warped arc of chaos qi round the body that strikes foes from varying directions at once.

name: Havoc Fist
description: Throw a fist with no set form that lands in a rough burst of qi and wrecks the foe's guard.

name: Mayhem Jab
description: Jab in a rough stuttering line so the foe cannot judge when the fist will arrive.

name: Frenzy Elbow
description: Whip an elbow in a wild arc from either side with qi bursting out at the point.

name: Rough Guard
description: Fling up both arms in a rough cover thick with loose qi that batters the blow aside.

name: Reckless Step
description: Dive into a foe's reach with no thought of the line taken and come up inside their guard.

name: Havoc Barrage
description: Throw a rapid run of blows in no order at head and body and legs until the guard collapses.

name: Riot Knuckle
description: Drive a knuckle loaded with riotous qi that hits hard and sets the foe's own flow into disorder.

name: Flow Snag
description: Hook a finger into the stream of the foe's qi and snag it so it stalls in one limb.

name: Tangle Palm
description: Strike so that the qi entering the foe splits and winds through the meridians in knots.

name: Crossed Current
description: Cross two currents of qi over the forearm so a blow that lands on them is turned aside.

name: Knotted Step
description: Cross the feet in a knotted pattern that carries the body clear of a straight rush.

name: Kink Strike
description: Strike a point where the meridian bends and kink the qi so it jams and stings.

name: Backflow Touch
description: Touch the foe's chest to turn a thread of their qi back on itself and blur their balance.

name: Meridian Snarl
description: Drive a strike into the meridians so the qi coils into a snarl that locks the nearest limb.

name: Choking Tangle
description: Hold a hand to the foe's chest and wind their qi tighter and tighter until movement fails.

name: Reversed Flow
description: Turn the flow of a foe's qi against its course so the technique they cast drains them instead.

name: Discord Pulse
description: Send a ringing pulse of clashing qi outward that shakes the balance of those close.

name: Clash Wave
description: Beat two palms together and let a wave of colliding qi roll out in front of the user.

name: Jangle Burst
description: Fling a jangling burst of qi that breaks into pieces mid-flight and strikes in several places.

name: Dissonant Guard
description: Fill the space before the body with clashing qi so blows lose their line and their force.

name: Jar Step
description: Stamp a jarring step that sends a small wave of disorder ahead and carries the body beyond it.

name: Warble Palm
description: Strike with a palm whose qi rises and falls in uneven waves and numbs the area it touches.

name: Static Touch
description: Touch a foe's hand with a crackle of rough qi that makes their fingers lose their grip.

name: Discord Surge
description: Heave a wide wave of clashing qi that knocks down foes and breaks the rhythm of techniques cast within it.

name: Uproar Burst
description: Burst a roaring wave of chaos qi outward so foes stagger and lose track of friend and foe.

name: Jarring Pulse
description: Pulse a jarring beat through the ground that rattles bones and interrupts any move begun nearby.

name: Smeared Guard
description: Smear the outline of the guard with moving qi so the foe cannot tell where it ends.

name: Murky Block
description: Cloud the arm with murky qi and turn a blow aside before the foe sees where it went.

name: Slippery Guard
description: Slick the forearms with shifting qi so every strike slides off at a new angle.

name: Counterspin
description: Spin against the line of a blocked strike and drive the back of the fist into the open side.

name: Smudge Ward
description: Hold a smudge of chaos qi in front of the body that spoils the aim of attacks entering it.

name: Obscure Step
description: Shift the footing through a blur of overlapping paces so the real position stays hidden.

name: Unreadable Guard
description: Hold a guard that changes shape with every breath so the foe wastes blows on spots that are not there.

name: Riddle Block
description: Meet a blow with a block that seems to open then turns the force round and returns a strike.

name: Unsteady Palm
description: Let the palm tremble as if weak then snap it firm as it meets the target.

name: Fumble Touch
description: Fumble at the foe's sleeve and slip qi into the wrist to loosen the hand's hold.

name: Slip Hook
description: Swing a hook that seems to slip past the foe then curls back to hit the side of the head.

name: Sway Guard
description: Sway the upper body with the force of the blow and push the striking arm wide.

name: Lurching Step
description: Lurch forward off balance on purpose and catch the weight on the next foot to land close.

name: Fumble Grasp
description: Seem to drop the grip then close both hands on the foe's arm and bind it with tangled qi.

name: Hand Havoc
description: Hammer the foe's hands with quick uneven taps until their fingers cannot hold a form.
